svg.aria-label: Our principles — simple by design, built to last. 01 Design for ease: simplicity isn’t the absence of features, it’s the absence of friction. 02 Engineer for scale: we build systems that are calm to operate and a delight to use. 03 Ship with purpose: every pixel and every endpoint has to earn its place.
